text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Mainichi Okan, an important 
stepping stone leading up to the Japan 
Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Given courage by Trainer, El Condor Pasa 
declared that she would settle the match 
by an overwhelming margin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, entering this race were Silence 
Suzuka, an Umamusume of rare genius, and 
her classmate Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To confirm whether she truly possessed the 
caliber to take on the Japan Cup, she 
headed into a race where formidable, 
highly skilled Umamusume awaited her.
